note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list as carried by the kit starter. Hidden flags follow the EGamers hidden table (27 bronze + 1 gold hidden, 28 total). Guides are written for this entry in our own words, each with its named sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one lands last by definition. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours — 60 to 80 of story, about 100 of checklist, about 10 of cleanup — so treat the platinum as the finish line, not a trophy to chase directly.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It pops as the story starts, so there is nothing to prepare — just play through the opening.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy — it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends. Do the first meditation in this chapter too (see Positive Mental Attitude) before moving on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only. The optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling is marked automatically in this chapter — take it when it appears, it is the natural first chance at Let's Go Bowling.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only — finish the chapter's missions in order and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The bank-vault robberies in this chapter also feed Maximum Withdrawal, so take the optional vault mission That's Where The Money Is... when it appears instead of rushing past it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. PowerPyx and GTABase both describe it as the story finale; it unlocks once the last mission is done, and it is the only hidden gold trophy on the list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission with no side requirement — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only — no preparation beyond playing the mission through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only — it pops when the mission is finished.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only — the airport mission, finished in order with the rest of the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. GTABase and PowerPyx both rank it the hardest trophy, though PowerPyx calls the thresholds lenient — roughly 60% of true completion. Most of it finishes itself while you chase the other trophies, and the checklist is completed after the story. The lenient counts: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count — 130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. EGamers notes flying under bridges is the quickest kind to grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types; sample one of each and the trophy pops on the ninth different type, so rotate through new activities rather than grinding one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across 12 shooting-range locations. Gold every one — the trophy needs all 42, not just most of them.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PowerPyx counts 42 races across 14 locations; win one race at each of the 14 spots and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count, across 40 race locations. The 100% checklist asks for 30 wins, so the trophy comes first on the way there.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activities the story introduces early, so the controls will already be familiar.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and finish one full game — the shortest cabinet you find is the fastest route.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's chain ends with this mission. Stranger quest givers stay around in free-roam after the story, so there is no rush — finish it before the platinum run ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is temporarily unavailable during Chapters 2–3 and returns later — the chain is not missable, so pick it up again when he comes back.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's chain to its last mission; like the other stranger chains it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Eight full stranger chains. PowerPyx notes the quest givers are still there in free-roam after the story, so none of them can be missed — start a chain as soon as it unlocks and work through it steadily.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's chain to its last mission; the chain stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's chain to its last mission; the chain stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations. THE ONE TO DO EARLY: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, happens only in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia walks to the balcony in the morning. Accept when she offers. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy, and both say it is unconfirmed whether this single session is strictly required — do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's chain and take the hunt when it is offered. EGamers notes which animal is still unconfirmed, so do not plan a route around a specific species until a second source names it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Any 3 sets count. There are more sets in the game than the trophy needs, and the 100% checklist asks for more still — sources differ on the full count, 15 or 18, so collect past the trophy if you are chasing 100%.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan 100 different spots. The 100% checklist asks for the same 100, so the trophy and the checklist finish together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Any 50 of the 80 challenges count. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so keep doing challenges past the trophy — the same sessions count for both.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break out of the red heat zone. Both PowerPyx and GTABase point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as the escape route, and bank vault robberies are a reliable way to reach 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while still wanted — the jewelry stores in North Vice City sit close together, which keeps the run short. If it does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTABase says you scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. Scanning traffic near busy roads is the efficient way. The 100% checklist asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past the trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle, and aim for gang members — PowerPyx notes cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase: steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away from the airport. The distance is the trigger, so keep flying until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. GTABase: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The tank itself is the tool — get in, then fight from the hatch.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. EGamers: open the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear the safe without anyone spotting you. Patience beats speed here — one detection voids the run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock only through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... — wait at the cafe when it appears. Follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open; expect 4 stars and keep a fast bike ready for the escape. 5 of the 8 vaults are needed for the trophy; all 8 count toward 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The easiest unlock is the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal — That's Where The Money Is... — which counts a vault robbery as an armored-truck robbery. Take the mission when it appears.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. This means clearing the fog across the whole map. EGamers: flying over the dark patches is reportedly the quickest method, since a plane covers ground a car cannot.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. One illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. GTABase counts 39 gang operations in total, so there is room to pick the easiest target per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, order an Apple Martini. This is a launch-era lead, not yet confirmed by a second source — check it against the guide before a dedicated trip.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx: a blue Banshee and the Key Cloner, then drive through the showroom window. A launch-era lead — GTABase agrees it involves crashing out through a showroom window, but the exact steps are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The robbery is introduced by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically in Chapter 2. Do it when it appears — the trophy is NOT missable, the robbery icon respawns if you miss a valuable, but the mission is the natural first chance. Kingpin Bowling, 3 valuables.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. PowerPyx: max out Strength for both characters at the same time. Train both characters' Strength to the cap together — one at max while the other lags does not count.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). GTABase: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — a single-source figure, so treat the count as a lead. Play normally and let the profile build; the trophy is tied to the Criminal Profile system, and PowerPyx notes the Irredeemable rating in that system is permanent, so check the profile guide before going on a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is still a lead: PowerPyx marks it not yet known, and the current lead points at the Payday Loans store. Do not plan a run around it until a second source confirms the steps.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx: a UFO north-west of the Starlet Motel, at night after 2AM. A launch-era lead — the exact trigger is unconfirmed, so treat the time and place as the starting point, not a guarantee.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The current lead is a motorcycle kick — knock someone down with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx marks the steps not yet known, so this is a lead, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through fences; GTABase notes one fence pays the most, and the total grows during the 100% robberies, so it accumulates while you work the crime trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It accumulates across the whole run, so it usually pops during normal play once you start buying gear, clothes and garages.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count toward the 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any 10 vehicles in the app — scanning and registering as you find them is the steady way, and it pairs naturally with Whip It Good.
